PainPoints.tagline: The Risk Matrix in Portuguese Real Estate
PainPoints.title: Why Buying or Selling Property in Portugal Demands Independent Legal Protection
PainPoints.subtitle: Portuguese property deals operate on strict contractual deadlines (CPCV). Without an independent lawyer auditing municipal records and tax encumbrances, buyers face severe risks.
PainPoints.card1Desc: In Portugal, debts and mortgages attach to the property deed. Without deep municipal registry audits, you could inherit millions in unpaid taxes or bank liens.
PainPoints.card2Desc: Renovations without municipal licenses (Câmara Municipal) can render a luxury Lisbon property un-resellable or subject to demolition orders.
PainPoints.card3Desc: Under Portuguese law, defaulting on a Promissory Contract (CPCV) can result in losing 100% of your deposit or double penalty damages.
PainPoints.card4Desc: Notarial deeds (Escritura) are legally binding only in Portuguese. Having a lawyer fluent in German, Dutch, English, and Portuguese prevents misinterpretation.

Expertise.title: Practice Areas & Legal Solutions
Expertise.subtitle: Comprehensive protection tailored for real estate transactions, corporate acquisitions, and estate inheritance in Lisbon and across Portugal.

realEstate.title: Real Estate Law & Acquisitions
realEstate.desc: Full-scope legal management of residential, commercial, and luxury property purchases across Lisbon, Cascais, and the Algarve.
realEstate.detail: From pre-purchase due diligence to negotiating the Promissory Contract (CPCV), verifying Habitation Licenses (Licença de Utilização), energy certificates, and executing the deed (Escritura Público).

notarial.title: Registration & Notarial Law
notarial.desc: Official representation at Portuguese notary offices and permanent land registry (Conservatória do Registo Predial).
notarial.detail: Handling NIF fiscal representation, bank account authorization, property tax (IMT and Stamp Duty) calculations, and title registration.

succession.title: Law of Succession & Estate Planning
succession.desc: Cross-border inheritance, estate planning, and property transfer management for international families.
succession.detail: Navigating European succession regulations (EU Regulation 650/2012), Portuguese inheritance taxes, and complex multi-heir estate distribution.

debt.title: Court-Ordered Debt Collection
debt.desc: Legal recovery of real estate claims, unpaid lease contracts, and contractual breach damages.
debt.detail: Initiating judicial order proceedings, asset freezing, and enforcement actions under Portuguese civil procedure law.

executive.title: Executive Law & Foreclosures
executive.desc: Representation in judicial auctions, mortgage foreclosures, and asset execution proceedings.
executive.detail: Protecting creditor rights or acquiring distress real estate assets through official judicial sale channels.

commercial.title: Commercial & Corporate Law
commercial.desc: Real estate holding creation, SPV structuring, and corporate lease negotiations.
commercial.detail: Establishing Portuguese commercial companies (Lda or S.A.), share transfer agreements, and commercial tenancy agreements.

public.title: Public Procurement Law
public.desc: Guidance on municipal zoning regulations, public tenders, and municipal licensing.
public.detail: Interfacing with Lisbon City Hall (Câmara Municipal de Lisboa) for urban rehabilitation approvals and municipal zoning compliance.

Process.title: The 4-Stage Property Acquisition Roadmap
Process.subtitle: How Larry Durei safeguards your investment from initial contract to final key handover.
Process.step1Desc: Exhaustive verification of the Caderneta Predial (tax card), Certidão do Registo Predial (title certificate), Licença de Utilização, and energy certificate to ensure 100% clean legal standing.
Process.step2Desc: Drafting and negotiating the Promissory Purchase Agreement (CPCV) with tailored clauses protecting your deposit against seller defaults or title defects.
Process.step3Desc: Calculating and submitting Municipal Property Transfer Tax (IMT) and Stamp Duty (Imposto de Selo), arranging fiscal numbers (NIF), and preparing notary filings.
Process.step4Desc: Live representation and official translation at the Notary Office during deed execution, followed by mandatory registration at the Conservatória do Registo Predial.
